title: Travis Walton abduction two weeks after NBC's The UFO Incident

tellings.quote: not that great. But what happens two weeks after the UFO incident, uh, Travis Walton gets abducted.

plain: In 1975, two weeks after NBC aired The UFO Incident, a TV film about an earlier abduction story, a man named Travis Walton said he had been abducted himself. The researcher Bryce Zabel points this out to Michels, without naming a source. He calls the film, which he connects to the actor James Earl Jones and the book The Interrupted Journey, "not that great", and his point is about timing: if one followed the other, a TV broadcast may have shaped what people later reported.
